title: CoMMa: Contribution-Aware Medical Multi-Agents for Decentralized Oncology Decision Support
abstract: arXiv:2602.09159v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent multi-agent frameworks have shown promise for oncology decision support, yet most assume centralized data access and rely on prompt-based assignment, limiting their applicability in privacy-sensitive clinical settings. We propose Contribution-Aware Medical Multi-Agents (CoMMa), a decentralized LLM-agent framework where specialists operate on partitioned clinical data streams. Unlike prior approaches that share inputs across agents, CoMMa enforces data decentralization to include stronger role specialization and further enhances this via agent-specific finetuning. To enable reliable and interpretable coordination, we introduce a contribution-aware aggregation mechanism that replaces stochastic, narrative-based reasoning with deterministic embedding projections to approximate each agent's marginal utility. translated_title: CoMMa：面向去中心化肿瘤学决策支持的贡献感知医疗多智能体框架
translated_abstract: 摘要：近期多智能体框架在肿瘤学决策支持方面展现出潜力，但大多数框架假设集中式数据访问，并依赖基于提示的任务分配，这限制了它们在隐私敏感的临床环境中的适用性。我们提出了贡献感知医疗多智能体（CoMMa），一种去中心化的LLM智能体框架，其中专家智能体在分区临床数据流上运行。与先前跨智能体共享输入的方法不同，CoMMa强制数据去中心化以增强角色专业化，并通过智能体特定微调进一步强化这一点。为实现可靠且可解释的协调，我们引入了一种贡献感知聚合机制，该机制用确定性嵌入投影替代随机、叙事性推理，以近似每个智能体的边际效用。这产生了对智能体的显式信用分配，提供了与临床实践一致的稳定、可解释的决策路径。
tldr: CoMMa通过去中心化数据访问和贡献感知聚合机制，实现了隐私保护下的肿瘤学多智能体决策支持，并用确定性嵌入投影替代随机推理，提供可解释的信用分配。
en_tdlr: CoMMa enables privacy-preserving oncology multi-agent decision support via decentralized data access and contribution-aware aggregation, replacing stochastic reasoning with deterministic embedding projections for interpretable credit assignment.
